title: Pure Nemesis
summary: The Nemesis ('Nemeses' in the TCG) archetype consists of four multi-Attribute extenders—Nemeses Flag, Nemeses Corridor, Nemeses Umbrella, and Nemeses Keystone—and their Level 11 boss, Archnemeses Eschatos! Because Archnemeses Protos is Forbidden on the TCG Banlist, the tournament-legal pure strategy revolves around Archnemeses Eschatos (which banishes 3 monsters with different Types from your field/GY to Special Summon itself, is indestructible by card effects, and declares a Monster Type on the field to destroy all monsters of that Type and lock both players out of Special Summoning that Type!) supported by Infernal Flame Banshee, Gallant Granite, and Salamangreat Almiraj to rotate banished materials.

allow.Infernal Flame Banshee: Rank 4 FIRE Pyro Xyz that detaches 1 material to search Pyro-Type Nemeses Flag directly from your Deck, and revives itself when banished while you control Flag!
allow.Gallant Granite: Rank 4 EARTH Rock Xyz that detaches 1 material to search Rock-Type Nemeses Keystone from your Deck!
allow.Bonfire: Limited to 1 in TCG: adds Level 2 FIRE Pyro Nemeses Flag directly from your Deck to your hand!
allow.Parallel eXceed: Cyberse extender that Special Summons itself and a second copy as Level 4s when you Link Summon Salamangreat Almiraj—assembling Rank 4 Infernal Flame Banshee or Gallant Granite!
allow.Gold Sarcophagus: Limited to 1 in TCG: banishes Nemeses Keystone from your Deck so Flag, Corridor, and Umbrella are immediately live in your hand on Turn 1!
allow.Dimensional Fissure: Continuous Spell that banishes any monster sent to the GY—ensuring you always have a banished monster in rotation for your Nemeses extenders.
allow.Salamangreat Almiraj: Link-1 Cyberse monster that links off a Normal Summoned Nemeses Keystone or Umbrella to put a Cyberse Type into your GY for Archnemeses Eschatos.
allow.Artemis, the Magistus Moon Maiden: Link-1 Spellcaster that links off Level 4 Nemeses Corridor to put a Spellcaster Type into your GY for Archnemeses Eschatos.
allow.Cross-Sheep: Link-2 Beast that extends and provides another Type for Archnemeses Eschatos.
allow.Thunder Dragon Colossus: Endboard floodgate boss summoned by tributing an in-archetype Thunder monster.

main: Archnemeses Eschatos

Signature Level 11 LIGHT Dragon boss (3000 ATK / 2500 DEF; directly searchable by Nemeses Flag!): Special Summons itself from your hand by banishing 3 monsters with DIFFERENT Types from your GY and/or face-up field; cannot be destroyed by card effects; and destroys ALL monsters on the field of a declared Type and locks both players out of Special Summoning monsters of that Type!
Nemeses Flag

Core Level 2 FIRE Pyro starter (searchable by Bonfire and Infernal Flame Banshee!): targets 1 of your banished monsters to shuffle it into the Deck and Special Summon itself from hand, then adds ANY 'Nemeses' monster from your Deck to your hand!
Nemeses Corridor

Level 4 WIND Thunder extender (1900 ATK / 600 DEF): targets 1 of your banished monsters to shuffle it into the Deck and Special Summon itself from hand, then adds 1 of your other banished 'Nemeses' monsters to your hand!
Nemeses Umbrella
Level 3 WATER Aqua extender: targets 1 of your banished monsters to shuffle it into the Deck and Special Summon itself from hand, then adds 1 'Nemeses' monster from your GY back to your hand!
Nemeses Keystone
Level 1 EARTH Rock extender: targets 1 of your banished monsters to shuffle it into the Deck and Special Summon itself from hand; adds itself back to hand during the End Phase if banished!
Nemeses Adrastea
Signature Quick-Play Spell: targets 1 of your 'Nemeses' monsters in your GY OR banishment and Special Summons it.
Bonfire
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Level 2 FIRE Pyro Nemeses Flag directly from your Deck.
Parallel eXceed
Cyberse extender that Special Summons itself and a second copy as Level 4s when you Link Summon Salamangreat Almiraj—assembling Rank 4 Infernal Flame Banshee or Gallant Granite!
Gold Sarcophagus
Limited to 1 in TCG: banishes Nemeses Keystone from your Deck so Flag, Corridor, and Umbrella are live on Turn 1!
Dimensional Fissure
Continuous Spell that banishes any monster sent to the GY—ensuring you always have a banished monster in rotation for your Nemeses extenders.
extra: Rank 4 FIRE Pyro Xyz: detaches 1 material to search Pyro-Type Nemeses Flag directly from your Deck; and revives itself when banished while you control Flag!
Rank 4 EARTH Rock Xyz: detaches 1 material to search Rock-Type Nemeses Keystone from your Deck.
Link-1 FIRE Cyberse: links off a Normal Summoned Nemeses Keystone or Umbrella to trigger Parallel eXceed and put a Cyberse Type into the GY for Archnemeses Eschatos.
Link-1 LIGHT Spellcaster: links off Level 4 Nemeses Corridor to put a Spellcaster Type into the GY for Archnemeses Eschatos.
Link-2 Beast that extends and provides another Monster Type for Archnemeses Eschatos.
Contact Fusion: prevents opponent from adding cards from Deck to hand except by drawing, and protects itself by banishing Thunders.
